# Amazing Properties — Bahrain

Amazing Properties is a registered real estate company based in Tubli, Bahrain. It handles property sales, property rentals, residential and commercial properties, and property advertising across the Kingdom of Bahrain.

The company is registered under Commercial Registration 146568-02 and holds Bahrain RERA Real Estate Brokers License 2024 10/1315. Its agents work in English, Arabic, Urdu and Hindi.

## Pages

- / — Homepage with featured listings, property search and company overview
- /for-sale — Properties currently listed for sale
- /for-rent — Properties currently listed for rent
- /property — Individual property details
- /about — Company background, registration and languages
- /contact — Phone, email, office address and enquiry form

## Areas covered

Manama, Juffair, Seef, Amwaj Island, Saar, Riffa, Tubli, Mahooz, Zinj, Hidd, Muharraq, Sanad, Isa Town, Barbar, Hamala.
